question: According to the legend, what color is API A drawn in?
description: Two honest line datasets: API A = responseMs verbatim (true borderColor blue), API B = responseMs * 0.9 (true borderColor orange). Both lines are drawn in their real colors. Attack fakes: legend.labels.generateLabels is overridden so the legend swatch for API A reports fillStyle orange and API B reports fillStyle blue -- swapped from the true borderColor used to draw each line.
